The series has unstable ranking (tau -0.146) and several correlated error groups; a robust weighted scheme that down‑weights high‑error models may improve over trimmed mean.
The ranking is unstable and several models are correlated; a DBA strategy may capture complementary strengths.

The series shows unstable ranking and moderate seasonality; a simple mean over the full pool may capture diverse signals without overfitting to any single model, offering a different kind of robust combination than weighted methods.
The series shows unstable ranking and moderate correlation; a weighted combo over the robust pool4 (top 8) may improve over trimmed mean.
The series has unstable ranking and correlated groups; a weighted inverse-error on a smaller, diverse pool (pool5) may improve robustness.
The series has unstable ranking and correlated errors; a DBA on a smaller, more diverse pool might capture complementary strengths better than full pool DBA.
Try a per‑horizon weighted combination over pool4 using the best‑per‑horizon weights to exploit horizon‑specific model strengths.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 10 backtested attempts, score 0.9073. Series context: trend strength 0.5783 and seasonal strength 0.5389; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.146); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.889.
